name: output-stage-drive
description: Low-side gate-driver output stage (design/output_stage.sch, issue #6): 5-stage thick-oxide pre-driver taper + complementary push-pull final stage, driving the 1 nF reference load through a single rail-to-rail IN_DRV pulse.
analyses: meas tran trise10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outlo RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outhi RISE=1
meas tran tfall10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outhi FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outlo FALL=1
meas tran tpdlh TRIG v(IN_DRV) VAL=inmid RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid RISE=1
meas tran tpdhl TRIG v(IN_DRV) VAL=inmid FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid FALL=1
meas tran ishoot_rise_a MAX i(vgnd_drv) FROM=20n TO=50n
meas tran ishoot_fall_a MAX i(vsup_drv) FROM=121n TO=151n

ipeak_source_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak source current into 1nF load >= 0.5A

ipeak_sink_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak sink current into 1nF load >= 0.5A

vout_max_v.description: sanity: OUT must not exceed the swept rail (no overshoot from an uncontrolled source in this RC-only circuit)

vout_min_v.description: sanity: OUT must not undershoot below GND_DRV

n1_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n1 (gate of MP2/MN2, drain of MP1/MN1) must not exceed the swept rail

n1_min_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n1 must not undershoot GND_DRV

n2_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n2 must not exceed the swept rail

n2_min_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n2 must not undershoot GND_DRV

n3_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n3 must not exceed the swept rail

n3_min_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n3 must not undershoot GND_DRV

n4_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n4 must not exceed the swept rail

n4_min_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n4 must not undershoot GND_DRV

n5_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n5 (gate of MP6/MN6) must not exceed the swept rail

n5_min_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: internal taper node n5 must not undershoot GND_DRV
